wish: someone should make an animated wizard's chess app
spec: Chess against a computer opponent, you play white on a phone-sized board. Tap a piece, tap a highlighted square; every capture stops the board for a short animated duel between the two pieces. Undo takes back your last move and the reply; it does not offer levels, underpromotion or online play.
notes: Offline. Opens on 1.e4 d5 with the e4 pawn selected so the first capture is one tap away; new game resets to the standard start. Promotion is always to a queen.
